permissions.name: Read State Services
permissions.description: Allows viewing the service registry, requests and dashboards

permissions.name: Submit Requests
permissions.description: Allows submitting, ingesting and cancelling service requests

permissions.name: Process Requests
permissions.description: Allows assigning, starting, completing and rejecting tasks

permissions.name: Delegate Requests
permissions.description: Allows forwarding a request to a lower organisational unit

permissions.name: Verify Fulfilment
permissions.description: Allows verifying or returning work completed by a lower unit

permissions.name: Configure Workflows
permissions.description: Allows managing units, workflows and service routing

permissions.name: View Reports
permissions.description: Allows reading supervisory dashboards across the authorised scope
